putaway.noStock: Choose the stock line to put away.
putaway.noLocation: This stock line has no location, so it cannot be moved. Give it a location first.
putaway.noTarget: Choose the bin or shelf to put it in.
putaway.sameLocation: Choose a different location from the one it is in.
putaway.otherSite: Put-away stays inside one site. Use a transfer to move stock to another site.
putaway.onlyFree: Only {free} is free to move (the rest is reserved).

pick.holdLine: This line is a job card hold, not a stock reservation. Reserve the stock for the job card first, then pick it.
pick.noJobCard: The job card number is missing.
pick.onlyReserved: Only {qty} is reserved for this job card on this line.

erp.notLedger: This file is not an ERP Stores Ledger (report CSOL-IMS-013-1).
erp.otherReport: The report is {report}, not the Stores Ledger ({expected}).
erp.noLines: The file has no stock lines.
erp.severalWarehouses: The file covers more than one store ({warehouses}). Export one store per file.
erp.rejectedRows: {count} rows could not be read. Fix them in the export and upload again.
erp.incomplete: The file has no end of report line; it may be cut off.
erp.totalMismatch: The lines add up to a different total than the file shows ({total}).
erp.noDate: The balance date could not be read.
erp.noCurrency: The currency could not be read.
erp.tooMany: The file has {count} item codes; one upload takes at most 5000. Split the export.

held.negative_qty: Negative quantity in the ERP. A count cannot be below zero; check it in the ERP.
held.below_reserved: Below the quantity reserved for job cards.
held.no_item: Item code not in the Material Master.
held.serial_tracked: Tyres and other serial-tracked items need their serial numbers; count them in Tyre custody.
held.missing_but_reserved: Not in the file, but reserved for a job card.

warranty.noStock: Choose the stock line the claim is for.
warranty.noQty: Enter how many units the claim covers.
warranty.overOnHand: The claim cannot cover more than the {onHand} on hand.

scrap.noStock: Choose the stock line to scrap.
scrap.noQty: Enter how many units to scrap.
scrap.overOnHand: You cannot scrap more than the {onHand} on hand.
scrap.noReason: Give the reason for scrapping (at least a few words).

reason.noBrandLine: Brand not stated on the stock line
reason.noBrandCatalogue: Brand not stated on the catalogue item

ledger_drift.label: Ledger differs from balance
ledger_drift.help: The sum of posted movements is not equal to the quantity on hand.

stock_qty_diff.label: Old stock quantity differs
stock_qty_diff.help: The legacy stock quantity column is not equal to the quantity on hand.

qty_no_ledger.label: Quantity with no movements
qty_no_ledger.help: The line holds quantity but no movement was ever posted for it.

reserved_mismatch.label: Reserved quantity differs
reserved_mismatch.help: Reserved quantity is not equal to the sum of reservation movements, or exceeds the quantity on hand.

negative.label: Negative stock
negative.help: Quantity on hand is below zero.

unvalued.label: Quantity without a value
unvalued.help: Part or all of the quantity on hand carries no cost.

unlinked.label: Not linked to Material Master
unlinked.help: The line has no Material Master item.

not_in_catalogue.label: Item not in the governed catalogue
not_in_catalogue.help: The Material Master item has no catalogue link.

finding.erpOnly: Issued in the ERP, not recorded as an issue in the store.
finding.storeOnly: Issued in the store, not in the ERP.
finding.unvalued: Store issues include unvalued quantity; the cost is unknown, not zero.
finding.differ: Quantities differ between the store and the ERP.
